comparator.name: Notarial Law
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official 2026–27 study product accounts for 180 EC across three 60-EC years. Year one consists of twelve 5-EC legal foundations; the zero-credit Leiden Law Practices items are omitted. Year two contains 45 EC compulsory law and business, a 5-EC restricted technology/law choice and 10 EC of programme optional subjects. Philosophy of Technology and Law is selected by official listing order. Year three contains 50 EC compulsory notarial/private-law study, one 5-EC notarial optional subject and a 5-EC thesis. The catalogue gives the programme optional subjects as placeholders rather than named choices, so they are represented transparently at group level. No formal route is selected.
components: Methods and Techniques of Legal Science
First listed course selected from the current 5-EC second-year restricted-choice group.
Optional Subjects I and II, Notarial Law
The current study product supplies two notarial-law optional-subject placeholders for this 10-EC group; represented at group level because no named component choices are published.
Corporate Structures and Legal Entities for the Civil-Law Notary
The notarial-law optional-subject placeholder is selected from the current 5-EC third-year elective group rather than the generic 15-EC faculty elective placeholder.

exception.reason: A valid 24-course UCR programme cannot represent this professionally structured Notarial Law bachelor. UCR provides a small general law cluster, including private, criminal, constitutional, international, European and human-rights law, but it has no sustained sequence in property and real-estate law, matrimonial property, succession, family law, company structures for civil-law notaries, tax law, civil procedure or notarial drafting and practice. Filling the programme with politics, philosophy or general business courses would not reproduce the target’s defining private-law and civil-law-notary preparation.
exception.curriculumContext: The complete 180-EC comparator progresses from a 60-EC general legal foundation to 60 EC combining obligations, property, family, company, administrative and European law, and then to 60 EC dominated by matrimonial property, succession, notarial corporate structures, civil procedure, real-estate law, a notarial moot court and thesis. The public programme description likewise identifies real-estate, company, matrimonial-property and inheritance law as the third-year core. No route is selected.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 rows of the current GitHub main data/reference/ucr_courses_enriched.xlsx, including descriptions, outline-derived profiles, topics, methods, prerequisites and planned Fall-2026-cohort availability. UCR offers GOSGATE102 Law, Society & Justice; GOSLAWJ111 Human Rights: Law & Philosophy; GOSLAWJ211 Criminal Law & Criminal Justice; GOSLAWJ212 Introduction to Public International Law; GOSLAWJ213 Comparative Constitutional Law; GOSLAWJ311 Principles of Private Law; GOSLAWJ312 Foundations of European Union Law; and BENBUSI311 Transnational Business Law. GOSLAWJ311 covers general obligations, tort and contract, and GOSGATE102 introduces property law, but there is no sequence in Dutch civil property law, conveyancing, real-estate law, matrimonial property, inheritance, family law, notarial company structures, tax law, civil procedure or notarial practice. Business and political-science courses can supply context, but cannot make 23 non-PPD courses substantively relevant to civil-law notarial training.
